propositions: DC renderer shells out to pandoc per field, incurring ~0.3s/field spawn cost and blocking reconcile passes indefinitely on pathological inputs (13.5-min CPU spin) due to lack of timeout.

Pandoc must be invoked via direct subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True) with caller-side wall-clock timeout (reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s, default 10s) and process-group reaping (rebar._proc.reap_process_group) to kill pipe-holding grandchildren on timeout, not just the direct child.

Contiguous runs of safe units must be batched into single pandoc invocations (one wiki segment per safe run) to reduce spawn overhead; dangerous units are spliced verbatim with no pandoc call and original block order is restored by concatenating segments.

On pandoc timeout or non-zero exit, the affected safe-run segment must degrade to verbatim Markdown without raising; other segments and dangerous units are unaffected (fallback boundary equals pandoc-invocation boundary).
The pypandoc-binary wheel must be pinned by version in pyproject.toml, the pin verified in CI, and the wheel-bundled pandoc GPL license recorded in the project SBOM/notice.
